comments.author: hannaho
comments.body: This will OOM prod! The batch accumulates every event in memory before flushing — a traffic spike blows the heap.

comments.author: ivanpetrov
comments.body: Measured: batches are capped at 1,000 events (~4MB) with a size-triggered flush, and the load test peaks at 38MB heap (run 7712). Bounded by construction; resolving as invalid.
